topic: Session pins are still never pruned
detail: SP-015 deletes command-log records but keeps every session_pins row, because retention counts from ended_at/exited_at and a resume continues a deleted chain from its pruned head. RC-50 (3) remains: sweeps and ListSessions read every pin. Proposal: delete a pin (and its pruned head) once its chain has no records left and it ended more than 90 days ago, or cap pins per harness process.
